name: Государственные праздники России — полный каталог (1991–2030)
title: Государственные праздники России — полный каталог (1991–2030)
description: Comprehensive Russian public-holiday catalog 1991–2030 generated from vacanza/holidays Russia.py at canonical pin 8086e609834c07df3f6179f05d864381ecba3453. Russia.supported_categories = ('public',) only — there is no workday/school/half_day subdivision in the upstream model. Russia.supported_languages = ('en_US', 'ru', 'th', 'zh_CN') giving four-language coverage: Russian (ru, native default), English (en_US), Thai (th) and Simplified Chinese (zh_CN, Mandarin). The Chinese translation channel is the dimensionally-unique feature among East-European Slavic vacanza datasets, reflecting the substantial Russian-Chinese trade/border community in the Russian Far East (Primorsky Krai, Khabarovsk, Amur Oblast) plus broader Mandarin-reading diaspora needs. Holidays covered include Новый год, Рождество Христово (Orthodox 7 Jan), День защитника Отечества (23 Feb, since 2002), Международный женский день (8 Mar), Праздник Весны и Труда (1 May; renamed from День международной солидарности трудящихся in 1992), День Победы (9 May), День России (12 Jun; observed 1992+ as День принятия Декларации о государственном суверенитете РСФСР, renamed 2002), День народного единства (4 Nov, since 2005), plus weekend-observed compensatory days and Long-Weekend-Bridge substituted days. Cyrillic, Thai and CJK Han scripts preserved verbatim via ensure_ascii=False. Russia has no per-federal-subject holiday subdivisions in vacanza (Russia.subdivisions = ()) — scope is uniformly 'national'.

meta.title: Государственные праздники России — полный каталог (1991–2030) - Бесплатная загрузка
meta.description: Comprehensive Russian public-holiday catalog 1991–2030 generated from vacanza/holidays Russia.py at canonical pin 8086e609834c07df3f6179f05d864381ecba3453. Russia.supported_categories = ('public',) only — there is no workday/school/half_day subdivision in the upstream model. Russia.supported_languages = ('en_US', 'ru', 'th', 'zh_CN') giving four-language coverage: Russian (ru, native default), English (en_US), Thai (th) and Simplified Chinese (zh_CN, Mandarin). The Chinese translation channel is the dimensionally-unique feature among East-European Slavic vacanza datasets, reflecting the substantial Russian-Chinese trade/border community in the Russian Far East (Primorsky Krai, Khabarovsk, Amur Oblast) plus broader Mandarin-reading diaspora needs. Holidays covered include Новый год, Рождество Христово (Orthodox 7 Jan), День защитника Отечества (23 Feb, since 2002), Международный женский день (8 Mar), Праздник Весны и Труда (1 May; renamed from День международной солидарности трудящихся in 1992), День Победы (9 May), День России (12 Jun; observed 1992+ as День принятия Декларации о государственном суверенитете РСФСР, renamed 2002), День народного единства (4 Nov, since 2005), plus weekend-observed compensatory days and Long-Weekend-Bridge substituted days. Cyrillic, Thai and CJK Han scripts preserved verbatim via ensure_ascii=False. Russia has no per-federal-subject holiday subdivisions in vacanza (Russia.subdivisions = ()) — scope is uniformly 'national'. Содержит 660 записей. Скачать в форматах Excel, CSV, PDF.
